summary: He (Morpheus) turns and rushes down the hall of the eighth floor. At the end of it, he finds the bricked-up windows. Cypher declares that this is what they changed and that they are trapped with no way out. The sound of heavy boot-steps closes around them. Morpheus asks Trinity for her phone; she objects that they will be able to track it. Morpheus insists they have no choice, and rips off his jacket.

what_changes.before: Unaware of what the enemy has done to their escape route.
what_changes.after: Realizes the windows have been bricked up, meaning they are trapped.
what_changes.evidence: That's what they changed.  We're trapped.  There's no way out.

what_changes.before: Rushing down the hall hoping to find an exit.
what_changes.after: Cornered, as boot-steps close around them and he decides to sacrifice the phone.
what_changes.evidence: The sound of heavy BOOT-STEPS close around them with the mechanical sureness of a vice.

what_changes.before: Holding her phone, reluctant to hand it over.
what_changes.after: Pressured to give it up despite the risk of being tracked.
what_changes.evidence: TRINITY They'll be able to track it. MORPHEUS We have no choice.

event_hint.one_line: The group is cornered on the eighth floor when they discover the windows bricked up, forcing Morpheus to use the traceable phone.

uncertain: Whether 'he' who rushes down the hall is Morpheus, since the scene does not name him until his dialogue.
Whether Trinity actually hands over the phone, since the scene ends as Morpheus rips off his jacket.
